items.title: Washing Hands
parts: Washing hands is a good habit.
Use soap and water before you eat. Rub, rub, rub!
Eating with dirty hands is not a good idea. Germs can make tummies upset.

items.title: Waiting Your Turn
parts: Waiting your turn is a kind choice.
When friends play on the swing, you can count to ten while you wait.
Pushing to go first is not kind. It can make others feel sad.
Waiting is hard, but you can do it. Everyone gets a turn!
